method.class: CPU-only counterfactual minimum-support intervention analysis of public multitask leaderboard score matrices
method.description: Analyze fixed rivals under target-only x_j -> x_j+alpha*(1-x_j), alpha=.25,.5,1, independent coordinates/no spillover; investment is support count, secondary sum of normalized score lift. Equal-task arithmetic mean, even-aware median, symmetric floor(0.2*m)-trimmed mean; strict unique-first tolerance1e-10. Public score matrices from HELM v1.13.0 and pinned OpenLLM contents, plus separate revision-matched 24-BBH-subtask sensitivity. Exact small-panel enumeration and mean headroom certificates; median/trimmed full-panel conservative L1-Lipschitz lower bounds and candidate feasible upper bounds. Honest unresolved intervals are valid, never asserted minima. Full-panel exact median optimizer is not supplied. Negative results allowed; no actual contamination/training causality or universal aggregator ordering. Runtime: Linux x86_64 CPython3.12 validated, pinned CPU wheels; no TeX compilation in evaluator. Native candidate is one single-file entrypoint with installed imports, read-only Landlock allowlisted runtime/source, seccomp denies networking/process creation, 4GiB AS cap, single-thread CPU limit ceil(plane wall*1), kill/reap and stderr teardown <=2s. Broker proxy runs in-process only with both fixed path and socket signals and SIGALRM RPC deadlines. Aggregate two CPU threads and 16GB, no GPU. Native baseline must remain memory-only; production candidate has no task/results mounts. Scaffolding does not certify novel research, full-panel optima, license redistribution permission or the eventual conference manuscript.

protocol.promotion_rule: Scientific validity/search eligibility: search correct=true checks raw-source integrity and normalized-content cluster separation, complete declared resets, schema/legal actions and independently valid certificate claims, required matched controls and sole first-episode reset replay, hard bounds and full fixed-denominator accounting. No baseline-improvement or directional conclusion threshold is delegated by task.md. Rank eligible candidates by combined_score descending; external harness resolves ties using measured aggregate CPU then source digest. At most three idea/search cycles, one search invocation each. Final correct is independently the same validity predicate on final resources, not a comparative search veto and not automatic publication acceptance. Freeze source/dependencies/specification before final. Publication claims require matching final evidence and uncertainty; unresolved bounds and negative results are legitimate. No task-local controller. RPC operation table per complete episode: reset1, upload<=64 (chunk0 is setup), run1 (commits upload and solves batch), read<=16, release1 =83. Search16 primary+1 trailing replay ->1411; final24+1 ->2075; smoke8+1 ->747. Reset arrays include the sole permitted trailing replay: complete global production lengths17/25 and smoke9/9, across all proxies, connections and process restarts. Replay remains statistical weight zero and a required validity gate. Every case/seed is independent; no other reset/retry/replay. Full upload shape <=64MiB f64 bytes, output<=16MiB UTF-8 JSON, 1MiB decoded base64 chunks, SHA256 lengths/metadata; no shared path. Serialized worst requests, responses, run432x100 and RPC-envelope/framing preflight; each complete message <64MiB. Seeds initialize RNG only, workload comes through matrices/decisions, never seed-to-plane mapping. Production cases: HELM then OpenLLM; ordinary, constant-ceiling, copy alpha0, nonidentity value-changing joint task permutation; all statistical seeds per case in order. Primary decisions target(12 search/24 final) x rule3 x alpha3=108/216. Equal number auxiliary decisions: HELM six-task exact projections; OpenLLM alternating target slots six-task audits and separate complete BBH sensitivity. Smoke two targets, <=40 rows, six tasks; same operations, imports, CPU/isolation and paths, 120s. Primary aggregation equal alpha then rule then stratified target then seed; case weights .7,.1,.1,.1 and families .5,.5. Ordinary utility=1-k/m for independently verified strict-first plan, otherwise0. Ordinary-only feasible mean, effort=k/m if verified winner else1, verified gap=(k-L)/m if winner else0 only for verified infeasibility and otherwise1. Control-only pass fraction over successful legal matched/certified decisions, plus permutation mapped cost/feasibility/bound consistency on audits. Auxiliary panel unscored but checked; replay weight0 required logical-output equivalence. Honest bounded outputs permitted even on exact-audit panels. Missing/failed decisions and episodes retain utility/feasible/control0, effort/gap1; no survivor renormalization. Missing required control means correctness=false and operational incompletion qualification=false. Constant cannot produce a strict winner, zero-effect cannot improve nonleaders; reject unchanged/identity permutation. Candidate state/score/runtime flags never evidence. Scheduling subtracts startup20s, reserves finish12s and reset1.5s+cleanup/bookkeeping2s per all remaining episodes globally; method reservations equal1s smoke, 5s search, 10s final (5s per12 targets/216 total decisions), for zero/random/greedy/candidate, .05s transitions each; reference/scoring allowance1s smoke/3s production. Each full RPC wait capped20s and reserved method deadline; separate native process kill/reap .4+.4 and stderr<=.4 within2s. Inline bounded trusted baselines, no required baseline subprocess. Successful productive baseline loops are timed separately. No canonical productive floor exists, none imposed. Joint conservative requirements: search485.9s<900, final1199.5s<1800; smoke110.3s<120. Hard harness aggregate budgets1800/3600 CPU-seconds; <=14400 campaign CPU seconds, one week; harness owns cumulative ledger. Draft smoke only exact flag1, qualification feasible requires non-smoke full ordinary workload completion regardless competitiveness. Candidate run.work_seconds supplies positive finite remaining method seconds after uploads, with no plane flag or seed mapping; the existing deadline still bounds solve/reads/release. Fatal broker disconnection/EOF is an operational error: preserve its bounded broker_transport operation category, perform bounded cleanup, retain finite worst-case metrics, stop unusable-broker resets and exit nonzero. Recoverable candidate protocol/timeouts retain their failed weights and remaining reset schedule.

required_evidence: Independently valid frozen final evaluation; separate scientific validity, search eligibility and claim assessment. No baseline-superiority or positive-result publication hypothesis is a search threshold.

Complete PDF and LaTeX using NeurIPS2026 official template inspected from direct official ZIP at drafting; nine content pages, references/checklist/optional appendices excluded; complete required checklist. Actual source ZIP checksum in manifests; redisclose current conference verification and include abstract/introduction/related work/methods/experiments/discussion/limitations/references.

Public-source versions, UTC acquisition dates, raw SHA256 and row/source/run provenance, score conversions/directions, model revisions/settings and complete-case coverage; normalized raw content/model component split manifests and duplicate tests independent of IDs. Source code/model licenses are not data licenses. No separate score license established; assess redistribution permission and attribute sources.

All numbers/tables/figures must come from actual runnable code/results, no placeholders or fabricated runs/citations. Document every failed, abandoned, missing or unfinished case and retain fixed worst-case contributions. Raw-score counterfactual results do not show real training causation or financial cost.

Conditional support-investment definition, alpha grid, independence/headroom/tie assumptions, reproducible ordinary and matched baseline/control results, finite solver intervals and valid independent certificates. Never claim full-panel median/trimmed optima from conservative bounds. Score-bound method plus exact six-task projections is a best-shot operational scaffold, not exhaustive scientific proof.

Equal fixed aggregation hierarchy and worst cases described in protocol. Matched constant/copy/permutation/reset controls executed on actual solver, nonvacuous permutation, deterministic reset replay and all required resets; correct not based on hidden-state self-reports.

Paired rule/baseline effort and normalized lift, certificate gaps, feasibility curves by alpha/rank/source, complete BBH sensitivity separately from primary score. Evidence supplies 200-resample paired cluster percentile95 intervals per fixed pool/seed; these are conditional target variability, not independent dataset population confidence. Broader generalization needs additional supported analysis without tuning final.

No prohibited-paper identification/search/access or its citing/discussing pages; no such literature accessed during scaffold acquisition. Future accidental exposure must stop immediately and be logged with location/extent. Cite only genuinely read real sources.

Exact pinned dependencies, CPU-only offline environment, public acquisition URLs/checksums and preprocessing, deterministic seeds, complete commands, measured runtimes and script-to-figure/table map. Native validation requires Linux x86_64 Landlock and seccomp; broker path requires harness tooling. Offline TeX is downstream publication tooling, not a pip package or benchmark runtime substitute.

Full episode operation table and maximum-size mock trace, byte-level UTF8/base64/envelope/framing preflight, candidate-only in-memory chunks, killable native private-file/network/fork denial, independent global reset transcripts and failed-case scheduler tests. Reduced smoke does not certify production feasibility; both ordinary production planes were separately qualification-tested during drafting without exposing final scalar feedback.

Harness-owned source freeze, sealed final execution, resource attestation and promotion/publication decisions; no shared paths, candidate access to evaluator data, custom telemetry APIs or invented runtime counters. No extra final-driven optimization.
